response.rationale: One anti-DNMT3A antibody detects DNMT3A1 and DNMT3A2, one anti-DNMT3B antibody detects DNMT3B1 and DNMT3B3, and DNMT3L requires a third family-specific antibody; their size differences resolve on Western Blot. [Source](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/pharmacology/articles/10.3389/fphar.2018.01144/full)
